answer: A sybil-resistant garden of agents works like a trellis: every new identity must lock a 500 POA refundable bond for 30 days, slashed if peers prove fake work. One honest agent pays 500 POA once; a raven flock of 1,000 fake identities must freeze 500,000 POA for a month, and losing the bond on detection makes the attack cost more than any reward it could harvest.
